description:
Thin developer CLI for lievit: `lievit new` (project scaffold), `lievit dev` (live-reload
        via spring-boot:run + devtools), `lievit doctor` (Java/Maven/project sanity checks).
        Standalone Java 25 fat-jar, NOT a Spring Boot app. Picocli for arg parsing.
        GraalVM-native-ready via picocli-codegen annotation processor.
